method: Clips played on the slot's retargeted model, sampled at 120 Hz. Ground speed of a clip = median horizontal speed of the ball-of-foot bone (LeftToes/RightToes) while within 3.5 cm of the clip's lowest foot height. Cross-check on Synty root-motion twins (source rig): walk 1.45 vs 1.45 m/s, run 2.49 vs 2.59 m/s, sprint 7.18 vs 7.24 m/s; planted feet in the root-motion twins read 0.04 / 0.15 / 0.42 m/s (residual noise of the method). Foot slide at game speed = |v_game - speed_ref * playback|, playback = clamp(v_game / map speed_ref, CharacterAnimator min..max).
